# `nlink-lab completions`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Print the shell completion script.

The script calls back into nlink-lab, so it completes what is on the host: labs, the nodes and endpoints of the lab on the line (or the current one), snapshots, tracked PIDs, a topology's `--set` params, templates, rule ids. Install it with: bash `source <(nlink-lab completions bash)` (in ~/.bashrc), zsh `source <(nlink-lab completions zsh)`, fish `nlink-lab completions fish | source`. `--static` prints a script that knows only the commands and flags.

Usage: nlink-lab completions [OPTIONS] <SHELL>

Arguments:
  <SHELL>
          Shell to generate completions for
          
          [possible values: bash, elvish, fish, powershell, zsh]

Options:
      --static
          A script that does not call back: commands and flags only

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
